content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where financial isolation and platform restrictions are a harsh reality, digital creators face significant barriers to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-music-online-accepting-bitcoin-explained-digital-creators-11|selling]] their products online. With Stripe and PayPal unavailable, many are left without a reliable means to collect [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-14|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s. This is where COREMERCH's sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-solana-payments-digital-products-stripe-6|The Full]] comes in, offering a solution that bypasses these restrictions and empowers creators to take control of their online stores.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to COREMERCH's infrastructure is its use of free and open tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, and Google Apps Script, which provide a reliable and cost-effective alternative to traditional platforms. By leveraging these tools, creators can build and deploy their own digital stores without relying on third-party services that may be restricted in their region. This approach also ensures that creators maintain full ownership and control over their stores and customer data.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying a digital store using COREMERCH's infrastructure, you'll need to have a clear understanding of your product offerings and target audience. You'll also need to set up a GitHub or Cloudflare account, depending on your chosen deployment method. Additionally, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account to enable crypto payments and integrate it with your store. With these components in place, you can begin building and deploying your store using the Sovereign Blueprint or by purchasing the Edge Commerce Stack ($197).
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to configure your NOWPayments account and integrate it with your store. This involves generating a payment gateway API key and setting up a webhook to notify your store when a payment is confirmed. You'll also need to configure your digital product delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. With these components in place, you can start accepting crypto payments and delivering digital products to your customers seamlessly.
Deploy a digital store with crypto payment processing in 48 hours or less using COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack ($197).
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is deployed and your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, you can go live and start processing transactions. This involves testing your store's functionality, ensuring that payments are being processed correctly, and verifying that digital products are being delivered as expected. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), you can rely on COREMERCH's 30-day support to help you navigate any issues that may arise during this process.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store grows and you start processing more transactions, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to ensure that it can handle the increased traffic. This involves monitoring your store's performance, optimizing your payment and delivery pipeline, and upgrading your infrastructure as needed. With COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can scale your store with confidence, knowing that you have full control over your infrastructure and can make changes as needed to ensure continued growth and success.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, you can use COREMERCH's Sovereign Blueprint, which provides a step-by-step guide to deploying a digital store using free and open tools like GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script. Alternatively, you can purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes a fully deployed store with crypto payment processing and digital product delivery, all set up and tested by COREMERCH's team.
Take control of your online store and customer data with COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For digital creators looking for a more comprehensive solution, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a fully deployed store with crypto payment processing, digital product delivery, and end-to-end testing. You can learn more about this solution and others by visiting the COREMERCH shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. By choosing COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can ensure that your digital store is built to last and can scale with your growing business.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a digital store using COREMERCH's infrastructure, follow these steps: set up a GitHub or Cloudflare account, create a NOWPayments account and generate a payment gateway API key, configure your digital product delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, deploy your store using the Sovereign Blueprint or Edge Commerce Stack ($197), test your store's functionality and ensure that payments are being processed correctly, and finally, go live and start processing transactions. With these steps complete, you can start selling your digital products and accepting crypto payments with confidence.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 is a basic deployment using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, while Stack 02 is a more comprehensive deployment using Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, with end-to-end testing and 30-day support.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, you can host a digital product store on either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, using COREMERCH's Sovereign Blueprint or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to deploy and configure your store.
How long does it take to deploy a digital store using COREMERCH's infrastructure?
Deployment times vary depending on the chosen stack, but Stack 01 can be deployed in 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, with end-to-end testing before handoff.
What is the cost of using COREMERCH's infrastructure?

The cost of using COREMERCH's infrastructure varies depending on the chosen solution, but the Sovereign Blueprint is available for $47, while the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes a fully deployed store with crypto payment processing and digital product delivery.
Do I need to have technical expertise to deploy a digital store using COREMERCH's infrastructure?

While technical expertise can be helpful, it is not required to deploy a digital store using COREMERCH's infrastructure, as the Sovereign Blueprint and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provide step-by-step guidance and support to ensure a successful deployment.
